originalProposals.reason: Defines biotechnology as using living cells to research and produce products; directly teaches the what-is-biotechnology facet of the G10 lesson.
Explains what meiosis II produces (four haploid cells from sister-chromatid separation); a substantive component of the mitosis/meiosis competency.
Teaches that traits are passed from parents to children; supports the inheritance component of DNA/genes/inheritance. Simplified but accurate at card level.
Names common metals as good conductors of heat and electricity; directly teaches the conductor component of the conductors/insulators competency.
Describes the giant three-dimensional metal lattice of repeating atoms; directly teaches the lattice component of lattices-and-molecules.
States the periodic trend of metallic character (increases down a group, to the left across a period); a genuine periodic-property teaching component.

Radiant-point geometry of meteor showers (parallel paths, same velocity) does not teach a small-body class, composition, or location; the same-velocity claim is also simplified. Potential destination G9-E-9 needs fit review.

Definitional career trivia (what meteorology/meteorologists are) does not teach a weather-record/pattern or typhoon competency component. Potential destination G3-E-4 only with substantive weather-pattern content.
Identifies the microwave band and its distinguishing uses; supports recognizing EM-spectrum bands. G10 EM-waves destination is enrichment-blocked for this card, G9 adopted instead.
Explains a distinguishing propagation property of microwaves vs other radio signals; supports the spectrum-reading competency. G10 destination enrichment-blocked, G9 adopted.
Presents shininess as an observable property of natural solid materials; supports the shine-property classification facet (jewelry use incidental).

Microscope mirror type detail (concave vs plain/compound) matches no authored unit pattern (parts/functions facets do not match) and is equipment trivia; destination G7-L-1 would need a mirror-part facet.
Teaches that inventions have effects in daily life, including negative ones when misused; a genuine component of the inventions-in-daily-life competency.
Explains mitosis as the division used in asexual reproduction producing two identical cells; teaches components of both the cell-division and reproduction-types competencies.
Explains why scientists use models (represent the too large/small/complex to observe directly); a direct match for the why-models competency.
Molar-mass calculation; G9 percentage-compositions destination is enrichment-blocked for this card and no other grade teaches molar mass as a core facet.
Empirical-to-molecular formula calculation; G9 destination enrichment-blocked and no authored unit elsewhere covers molecular formulas.
Organic-vs-inorganic molecule size comparison belongs to G9 organic-compounds content, which is enrichment-blocked for this card; the particle-model lesson is not genuinely taught by it.
Mole calculation from molar mass; G9 mole-calculations destination is enrichment-blocked and moles are not a core facet in any other grade.
Mole calculation from molar mass; G9 mole-calculations destination is enrichment-blocked and moles are not a core facet in any other grade.
Gives everyday applications of conservation of linear momentum (skateboarding, crashes, rockets, recoil); directly supports the conservation facet.
Menstrual-cycle cadence card matches no authored unit pattern (no menstruation/month facet exists); destination would need a new g5 reproductive-system unit facet.
Ethnoastronomy belief card (moon phases as birth/life/death) matches no authored unit pattern; potential destination G6-E-10 needs a beliefs facet authored.
Myth-debunk card teaches plant-growth factors (soil, water, climate), not a sky-navigation/seasons competency component; potential destination G6-E-9/G6-E-10 folklore-evaluation facet.
Describes the Moon revolving around Earth in an orbit while Earth orbits the Sun; a direct component of the Sun-Earth-Moon relative-motion competency.
Describes the observed downward motion of the Full Moon toward the western horizon overnight; supports the apparent-sky-motion recording competency.
Links longer daylight hours to more received solar energy and warmer days; directly teaches the day-length component of the seasons competency.
Documents a Philippine star-lore identification (Moroporo = Pleiades); directly supports the community-sky-knowledge competency (constellation/calendar patterns).

Morse SOS card mentions no sound/light/movement keyword the authored message units require; pattern misses and the content is communications-history trivia for this grade band. Potential destination G3-F-8 only with a coded-signal facet.
Explains that reversing current polarity reverses motor rotation direction; a genuine motor-behavior component of the motors/generators competency.
Explains that reverse faults (plate push-together, one block overriding) built the Himalayas and Rockies; directly teaches the reverse-fault classification facet.

Molecular-common-ancestor evidence card matches no authored unit pattern (G10-L-3/L-5 facets require natural-selection or fossil/morphology wording); potential destination G10-L-5 needs a molecular-evidence facet.
Explains how a movable pulley behaves (moves with the load); a genuine simple-machine component. Content is G6-destined despite g5-level tag.

Plate-motion summary uses plain-language toward/away/past wording; authored boundary units require divergent/convergent/transform keywords, so no facet match. Potential destination G9-E-3/G10-E-2 with loosened facet wording.
Explains multiple alleles (ABO) as more than two allele forms of one gene in a population; a gene/inheritance-vocabulary component of DNA/genes/inheritance.
Mumps symptom trivia (swollen glands) is health/disease advice, not a component of any selected core facet; retain for separate health review.
Links outdoor mural painting to the dry season (paint dries, not washed away by rain); a concrete seasonal-activity component of the Philippine-seasons competency.
Relates muscle cells having more mitochondria to energy needs; teaches the mitochondria component of cell observation.
History-of-science naming trivia for charges; G7 charging-processes destination is grade-scoped-excluded for this card and no other unit matches.
Explains the etymology of the Cretaceous Period (Latin creta, chalk); supports the geologic-period recognition component of the geologic-time competency.
Describes the National Framework Strategy under the Climate Change Act as the plan for adaptation and mitigation; a climate-action component.
Classifies typhoons, floods, lightning as natural events and names weather examples; supports the weather-pattern recognition competency (natural-events framing, not process-skills).
Distinguishes natural from artificial light sources with examples; directly teaches the light-sources facet.
Identifies Sun, Moon, stars, planets (with clouds/birds) as natural sky objects; supports the sky-objects competency. Clouds/birds inclusion is loose but the core teaching holds.

Identifies nitrogen as the most abundant gas in air; a direct component of the air-mixture competency.

Road-sign trivia with no science teaching component; matches no authored unit. Enrichment/civic content only.

Explains gravity as a non-contact force pulling without touching; a direct component of the gravity/non-contact-force competency.
